basic_details.short_information: Only retired Defence Services personnel of the waiter trade with Punjab domicile can apply for the one contractual Waiter (Ex-Servicemen) post at Punjab Ex-Servicemen Corporation (PESCO), Chandigarh, a Punjab Government Undertaking. The post carries a basic salary of Rs 24,494/- (DC Rate), candidates must be less than 55 years as on 01 Nov 2026, and the bio-data must be emailed to [email protected] or sent by post / delivered at the PESCO Head Office by 24 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Candidates must be less than 55 years as on 01 Nov 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

qualification.details: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The bio-data format, however, asks candidates to state their civil education ("Education Civil") and the year of "Matric with Punjabi". Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: The notice allows the bio-data to be sent by email or by post / physical delivery, by 24 November 2026.

Prepare the bio-data (resume) in the format printed in the notice, with these columns: Ser No; Rank & Name; Address, Contact No & E-mail ID; DOB & Age; Med Cat; Domicile; Education Civil; Matric with Punjabi (year); Experience.
Attach a copy of your Record of Service, your PPO and a photograph.
Email the bio-data with these documents to [email protected] by 24 Nov 2026.
Alternatively, send it by post or deliver it physically at PESCO Head Office, SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh - 160022, by the same date.
important_instructions: For details, the notice directs candidates to www.pesco.punjab.gov.in. PESCO contact number printed in the notice: 0172-2620423.

content_sections.heading: About PESCO
content_sections.text: Punjab Ex-Servicemen Corporation (PESCO) is a Punjab Government Undertaking with its office at SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh. The notice is issued under the heading "Government of Punjab", and in it PESCO says it requires medically fit retired Defence Services personnel on contractual basis. The Waiter post is in the Department of Punjab Ex-Servicemen Corporation at this Chandigarh address.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single Waiter post is reserved for ex-servicemen: the notice describes it as "Only Ex-Servicemen of waiter trade" and asks for "An experienced retired Defence Services Waiter (Waiter Trade)". Candidates must meet all of the following conditions printed in the notice: Retired Defence Services personnel who are medically fit. Experienced Waiter of the Waiter Trade in the Defence Services. Working knowledge of Punjabi. Punjab Domicile. Proficiency in waiter trade. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The bio-data format, however, asks candidates to state their civil education ("Education Civil") and the year of "Matric with Punjabi". Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post. Candidates must be less than 55 years as on 01 Nov 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PESCO Waiter (Ex-Servicemen)
content_sections.text: The notice allows the bio-data to be sent by email or by post / physical delivery, by 24 November 2026. Prepare the bio-data (resume) in the format printed in the notice, with these columns: Ser No; Rank & Name; Address, Contact No & E-mail ID; DOB & Age; Med Cat; Domicile; Education Civil; Matric with Punjabi (year); Experience. Attach a copy of your Record of Service, your PPO and a photograph. Email the bio-data with these documents to [email protected] by 24 Nov 2026. Alternatively, send it by post or deliver it physically at PESCO Head Office, SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh - 160022, by the same date. Bio-data in the prescribed format Copy of Record of Service PPO Photograph

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: According to the notice, only eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The interview date will be intimated later. The notice does not mention a written test or any other stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: For details, the notice directs candidates to www.pesco.punjab.gov.in . PESCO contact number printed in the notice: 0172-2620423.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PESCO Waiter Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Waiter (Ex-Servicemen), on contractual basis, open only to ex-servicemen of waiter trade.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PESCO Waiter post?
faq.answer: The bio-data must be sent by 24 November 2026, by email or by post / physical delivery.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the PESCO Waiter post?
faq.answer: The candidate must be an experienced retired Defence Services Waiter (Waiter Trade), with working knowledge of Punjabi, Punjab domicile and proficiency in waiter trade. The notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the PESCO Waiter post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be less than 55 years as on 01 Nov 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the PESCO Waiter post?
faq.answer: The notice states "Salary Basic Rs 24,494/- (DC Rate)".

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the PESCO Waiter post?
faq.answer: Email your bio-data in the prescribed format with a copy of Record of Service, PPO and photograph to [email protected], or send it by post / deliver it at PESCO Head Office, SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh - 160022, by 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the PESCO Waiter post?
faq.answer: Only eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, and the interview date will be intimated later.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired Defence Services personnel apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Yes, the post is only for medically fit retired Defence Services personnel of the waiter trade. The pay is a basic salary of Rs 24,494/- at the DC Rate.

faq.question: Q9. Is the PESCO Waiter post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the Waiter (Ex-Servicemen) post is on contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need Punjab domicile for the PESCO Waiter post?
faq.answer: Yes, Punjab domicile is required, along with working knowledge of Punjabi and proficiency in waiter trade.
